capabilities: Copy the note or selection to clipboard without frontmatter, wikilinks, tags, block IDs and callout syntax
Turn wikilinks into plain text during copy
Optionally strip all Markdown formatting such as bold, italic and headings
Toggle which elements get removed in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author got tired of pasting notes and seeing the YAML frontmatter at the top, so built the plugin to copy a cleaned version.
problem: Copying a note pastes the YAML frontmatter and Obsidian-specific syntax along with the content, requiring manual cleanup before pasting elsewhere.
summary: Clipboard copy utility that copies the current note or selection with frontmatter, wikilinks, tags, block IDs and callout syntax removed.
